entries.english:
30.09.1495: Joint seal document (Verbundbrief) of Engelbrecht von Haizfelt, Johan von Holzheym, and Syfrit Rosenberger.

Sealers: S1: Engelbrecht von Haizfelt (brown wax, diameter 2.3 cm, well preserved) on parchment strip. S2: Johann von Holzheim (brown wax, diameter 3 cm, well preserved) on parchment strip. S3: Friedrich von Feilsch, Captain of Frankfurt (brown wax, diameter 2.7 cm, well preserved) on parchment strip.
